newsitem.title: USA: LCI says new service cuts customers' bills.
newsitem.headline: LCI says new service cuts customers' bills.

text.p: LCI International Inc, a voice and data transmission services company, said Monday it was offering its Simply Guaranteed PLUS service that it said would reduce bills of commercial customers spending between $100 and $100,000 a month on telecommunications services.

The company said the new service offers a full range of voice and data services with tariffed interstate base rates that are, on average, 30 percent lower than comparable services offered by its competitors.
It said the service also gives customers an additional rate reduction that is automatically applied to their bills when their usage exceeds the next highest monthly commitment level.
For example, if a business that normally spends $1,000 a month on telecommunications services spends $2,000 in a given month, that month's bill will receive the additional discount, it said.
